title: A test: silicon ore (with iron and copper) gathered at Floodlight Flats (Subra, lawless) into storage at The Crescent Moon (Mebsuta, two jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-17 15:08 UTC (orders.log ENT-037, block ZERO: silicon ore first where a field has it; rules F3, F13, F24). Floodlight Flats read silicon 3,187 of 20,000 at richness 43, iron 95,232 (45), copper 100,000 (30), neodymium 1,666 (11) (scouting/subra.json, 2026-11-17 10:27 UTC): the nearest silicon field with a load in it after Glasslight Shoal, which is Logistics' test. The reserve is short of 52,364 silicon ore and holds 736 (the tool stock, view=reserve, 15:04 UTC); stations ask 325 to 632 cr a unit. The nearest station is The Crescent Moon in Mebsuta, two jumps by Porrima (a station of the faction tagged MOON with storage; scouting/mebsuta.json); Subra lies 10 jumps from The Experiment by Ironhollow, GSC-0041, Antares, LHS 1140, HD 147513, Gudja, Pipirima, Adhara and Porrima, no pirate on our record on that road (observations, kind pirate, 15:10 UTC). Stores everything, sells nothing (rule F24): the silicon waits there for a carry home or a craft. One ship with an empty hold until its first RESULT line (rules F8, F13); no lift_to before it; min_left keeps one load of silicon in the field. 2026-11-17 23:16 UTC (Zero): three full runs of 90 to 94 minutes, 422 to 464 ore each, -35 to -43 cr; 478 silicon in storage at The Crescent Moon (data/stock/storage.json): about a third of each load. The field rose 3,187 -> 3,739 silicon between 10:27 and 21:30 UTC while one ship took about 480: about 90 an hour back. max_ships 1 -> 2, min_left silicon 65 -> 500. 2026-11-21 19:37 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 2 -> 8.
